# Saksham Arora

> Systems and quant engineer. I build low-latency tooling for markets and for AI.

CS undergrad at IIT Madras (Online BS). My focus is the layer where performance is measured in microseconds and percentiles: high-frequency trading systems, lock-free C++, quantitative engineering, and applying that same rigor to AI tooling.

## Currently building

- llm-bench: LLM API latency benchmarker with p50/p95/p99 reporting
- lockfree-cpp: lock-free C++20 concurrent data structures

## Selected work

- HFT matching engine: low-latency order matching, 2.7M ops/sec, p99 900ns, 3.31x over baseline, 21 tests
- IMC Prosperity 4: global quant trading competition, top 0.5% of 18,800+ teams
